title: Dosing Capsules for HERBS – 8 Pack with Magazine
description:
Elevate your vaping experience with the Storz & Bickel Dosing Capsules for Herbs – 8 Pack with Magazine. Designed for unparalleled convenience and efficiency, this essential accessory allows you to preload and store your dry herbs in eight individual dosing capsules. Perfectly compatible with the Crafty and Mighty vaporizers, each dosed capsule ensures a consistent and optimal herbal experience.

The included magazine keeps your capsules organized and ready for use, streamlining your vaping process and ensuring a fast, easy order every time. Whether at home or on-the-go, this pack makes herb storage and vaporizer loading effortless. Enhance your sessions with this must-have companion for any Crafty or Mighty owner.
